mechanism: CrashClassifyScript tracks a running prev_high on monthly stock prices and labels a crash (0) when ((prev_high - price) / prev_high)*100 > 10, else no-crash (1). That binary Trend column becomes the supervised target for logistic regression on macro features.
data_needed: Monthly close prices from Dec 2009; running peak; 10% drawdown threshold
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Apple (AAPL) and Netflix monthly 2010–2022; Fed funds, CPI/Core CPI, EPS, PE
why_new_for_mis: Explicit >10%-from-peak crash detector is a reusable regime-change labeler MIS can attach to any instrument before feeding macro/fundamental covariates.
quote: based on the definition of a crash; markets has to fall more than 10% percent if (percent_crash > 10) out_binary[prev] = 0; //downtrend (crash)

mechanism: After corrcoeff filtering, logistic regression classifies monthly crash/no-crash using Core CPI, EPS, and Fed funds (Apple; ~70% test acc) or EPS, Core CPI, CPI (Netflix; ~59%). Predictions stored by date drive EA buy/sell flips on matching D1 bars.
data_needed: Core CPI, CPI, Fed funds rate, EPS, PE; crash Trend labels; 70/30 train-test
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: AAPL and NFLX monthly features; EA tests on daily bars matching prediction dates
why_new_for_mis: Macro-conditioned crash/no-crash classifier is a slow-horizon regime sensor MIS can run beside price-only detectors.
quote: We are going to use only the three independent variables to build up our model which are, Core CPI ... EPS ... Lastly, the FEDs fund rate

mechanism: Full read: builds ID3 classification tree (entropy, information gain, leaf removal) on the PlayTennis weather dataset (Outlook/Temp/Humidity/Wind). Mentions trading use only as future hope; no market features, labels, or sensors are implemented.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: None (tennis weather toy set; EURUSD H1 only as chart host for TestScript)

quote: for the sake of building the basic library, we are going to use the simple dataset of playing tennis in certain weather conditions

mechanism: Full read: derives and codes gradient descent for MSE linear regression (Salary years→pay) and BCE logistic (Titanic Pclass→Survived), plus MinMaxScaler. No market regime/vol/liquidity/sequence sensing is built—optimization primer for later NNs.

why_new_for_mis: After full read this is a calculus/optimization tutorial, not a market sensing construction.
quote: Gradient Descent aims at minimizing the cost function because the model with the lowest cost function is the best model.

mechanism: CKNNNearestNeighbors stores ATR and Volumes as features; target=1 if close>open else 0. Euclidean distance to k odd neighbors votes bull/bear. Tuned k~44–45 reaches ~66% train-test acc on EURUSD D1; OnTick re-queries live ATR+volume for signal.
data_needed: iATR + iVolumes buffers; MqlRates open/close labels; odd k; TrainTest split
why_new_for_mis: Joint ATR–volume neighborhood vote is a local volatility/participation proximity sensor for directional regime without parametric assumptions.
quote: The independent variables of choice are the readings from the ATR and the Volumes indicator, while the target variable will be set to 1 if the market went up and 0 if the market went down

mechanism: Single-hidden-layer regressor NN (He init, ReLU, MSE, delta-rule backprop) maps MinMax-scaled Apple and Tesco open prices to NAS100 close. Train/test split with random_state=42; live ForwardPass predicts index level; trades if pred vs ask/bid gap exceeds stops level with TP/SL scaled to target_gap.
data_needed: CopyRates opens for symbol_x/symbol_x2; NAS100 closes; NORM_MIN_MAX_SCALER; epochs/alpha
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NAS100 chart; Apple_Inc_(AAPL.O) + Tesco_(TSCO.L); M30 training note, H4 tester Jan–Feb 2023
why_new_for_mis: Cross-name regressor treating mega-cap opens as sensors for index level is a multi-instrument neural path MIS can reuse for lead–lag sensing.
quote: I used Tesla Stock and Apple stocks as my independent variables when trying to predict the NASDAQ(NAS 100) Index.

mechanism: CDecisionTree (Gini/entropy, recursive best-split on thresholds) trained on RSI + Stochastic main/signal buffers; target +1 if close>open else −1. Prints tree of RSI/Stoch thresholds; OnTick predict drives buy/sell. Train ~60%, test ~50.5% on EURUSD H1 with min_samples=3, max_depth=5.
data_needed: iRSI + iStochastic buffers; open/close labels; TrainTestSplit 0.8; tree hyperparameters
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD PERIOD_H1 (and PERIOD_CURRENT); train_bars window; tester 2023.01–2023.02 open prices
why_new_for_mis: Interpretable RSI/Stoch threshold tree is an oscillator-regime sensor whose printed splits MIS can audit as human-readable rules.
quote: We want to use the decision tree AI model to make predictions on the current bar to possibly tell us where the market is heading, either up or down.

mechanism: CRandomForestClassifier builds n_trees (default 100) DecisionTreeClassifiers on bootstrapped (replace=true) randomized subsets; predict takes mode of tree votes via Unique_count ArgMax. Compared to single tree on same forex data: higher paper accuracy but worse tester PnL until SL/TP tuned—ensemble diversity as sensing robustness lever.
data_needed: Same labeled feature matrix as trees; n_trees, minsplit, maxdepth, random_state, bagging replace
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Forex EA RandomForest Test; tester 2022.01–2023.02 open prices, $1000, 1/100
why_new_for_mis: Bootstrap-aggregated tree majority vote is an ensemble regime sensor that MIS can compare to single-tree rules for stability under noise.
quote: A Random Forest is an ensemble learning method that operates by constructing many decision trees during training and outputs the class, that is, the mode of the classes (classification) or mean prediction (regression) of the individual trees.

mechanism: CTruncatedSVD centers GetAllBuffers (56 MT5 indicator buffers), SVD on covariance, selects k via explained-variance ArgMax (elbow≈11 on full set), projects to low-D components for linear regression of close. Train R²≈0.81 / test≈0.73 vs raw 56-col failure (nan). NMF competitor blew up to nan on same stack.
data_needed: All indicator buffers matrix; target closes; explained-variance plot; optional NORM_STANDARDIZATION on LR
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; ~100 bars demo then full 56-buffer stack; buffer_size configurable
why_new_for_mis: Explained-variance elbow compression of the full indicator soup into ~11 orthogonal components is a dimensionality sensing front-end for MIS multi-indicator regimes.
quote: CTruncatedSVD::fit_transform Best value of K = 11 ... Train acc = 0.8087284075835584 Test acc = 0.7286157353628964

mechanism: AdaBoost trains n_estimators decision stumps/logistic models on bootstrapped, StandardScaler-normalized Bollinger mid/upper/lower; instance weights upweight misclassified bars; alphas weight learners; majority ArgMax vote. Decision-tree path uses 3-class buy/sell/hold (close vs open); logistic uses binary. Tested EURUSD H1 and H12.
data_needed: iBands 3 buffers; target from close vs open; n_estimators, tree depth/split, bootstrapping
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; H1 (train_bars=1000) and H12 (train_bars=100); Jan 2020–Feb 2023 tester
why_new_for_mis: Adaptive reweighting of hard bars around BB envelopes is a boosting regime sensor that focuses capacity on misclassified states.
quote: By using the Bollinger band indicator applied to the open price, we are trying to train our models to learn to predict the next close candle whether it is bullish, bearish or none of the two(HOLD).

mechanism: CLDA builds within/between-class scatter from labeled bars (close>open→1 else 0), eigendecomposes SW^{-1}SB with reg_param, keeps components via scree/variance/Kaiser, projects AMA/ADX/ADXWilder/Bands/DEMA into class-separating subspace; decision tree trades on transformed coords. LDA train/test≈0.55/0.54 vs PCA 0.59/0.50 on EURUSD H1.
data_needed: 5 trend-indicator handles; binary OHLC labels; LDA fit_transform then transform on live inputs
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; bars train window; tester 2023.01–2024.02 open prices
why_new_for_mis: Supervised LDA projection maximizes between-class scatter of trend indicators—MIS class-aware dim-reduction sensor unlike unsupervised PCA/SVD.
quote: LDA aims to find linear combinations of features that maximize the separation between classes in the data.

mechanism: Feature-engineering script builds 26 inputs: current OHLC, 3 lags of OHLC, 30-day SMA, 7-day StdDev, DAY/DAYOFWEEK/DAYOFYEAR/MONTH, lag-1 OHLC diffs; LightGBM classifier (gbdt, binary) on next-bar close>open via StandardScaler pipeline→ONNX. EURUSD D1; tester ~51% with 500/700 pt SL/TP.
data_needed: CopyRates OHLC+time; iMA(30), iStdDev(7); MqlDateTime fields; LightGBM ONNX
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD PERIOD_D1 features (~1000 bars); EA tested on lower TF open-prices modelling
why_new_for_mis: Lagged+rolling+calendar stack shows classical GBDT can act as a time-series sensor when temporal features are engineered explicitly for MIS.
quote: By introducing lagged features to our data we ensure to capture temporal dependencies from prior bars which definitely has something to do with the current bar price.

mechanism: Augmented Dickey-Fuller test flags which engineered columns are stationary (7DAY_STDDEV, calendar fields, DIFF_LAG1_OHLC among 9/27). Rolling 7-day StdDev is kept as an explicit short-horizon volatility feature; article argues stationarity of the target (first-diff closes) can improve TS methods even when LightGBM prefers non-stationary OHLC levels.
data_needed: statsmodels adfuller on each column; iStdDev(7) buffer; optional first-order close differencing
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD D1 feature frame; ADF signif=0.05
why_new_for_mis: ADF gate plus dedicated rolling StdDev column is a stationarity/volatility sensing checklist MIS can run before choosing level vs return models.
quote: Out of 27 Variables, only 9 variables were detected stationary. These variables are: 1. 7DAY_STDDEV ... 6. DIFF_LAG1_OPEN ...

mechanism: CalculateDivergenceShift: Slope_P=(P0−P_{N−1})/N, Slope_I similarly; NormSlope_P=Slope_P/P_{N−1}; Delta_div=indSlope−normPriceSlope. Fires when |Delta_div| exceeds InpDivergThreshold. Orthogonal RSI (close-velocity) + DeMarker (intra-bar extremes) fed separately or combined so concurrent divergences reduce false breaks.
data_needed: priceData[] and indicatorData[] over InpLookbackWindow; RSI + DeMarker handles; divergence threshold
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPJPY PERIOD_H2; lookback optimized to 44; threshold 0.012; opt 2025 then forward 2026.01–05
why_new_for_mis: Normalized slope differential between price and momentum is a velocity-regime-change sensor that flags hidden accumulation/exhaustion before lagging breakouts.
quote: The hidden shift in momentum or divergence differences (Delta_div) can then be isolated by getting the direct variance between these two normalized trajectories

mechanism: EvaluateTFTNetwork maps three temporal divergence states t1/t2/t3 with fixed multi-head weights (0.55/0.30/0.15), ReLU-style split into attentionBuy vs attentionSell matrices, and mutual-exclusivity breakout only if one side ≥ InpAttentionThresh while the other stays subcritical. Hybrid mode feeds price auto-divergence, RSI divergence, and DeMarker divergence as the three heads.
data_needed: Three divergence scalars; InpAttentionThresh; optional InpUseTFT flag; new-bar lock
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPJPY H2; modes include HYBRID_FULL; opt found best settings with TFT off (raw divergence alone)
why_new_for_mis: Lightweight multi-horizon attention gate over competing divergence tracks is a sequence sensor MIS can use to enforce one-sided structural breakouts and suppress chaotic two-sided spikes.
quote: a structural attention breakout fires only when one attention track goes past the threshold parameter while the opposing direction remains subcritical
